law: MY CURRENT RECONSTRUCTION — the founder's chosen interpretation of disputed relationships, dated and explainable, carried ALONGSIDE the underlying records. Choosing never erases: every change appends a new version; earlier versions (including the walked record itself and Marilyn's work) remain fully readable. A reconstruction chooses among hypotheses; it never upgrades evidence classes.
